subject: SOW & evidence access for annual application security assessment
messages:
From: BlackPeak Security <engaging@blackpeaksec.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-04-18T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Proposal — Redwood annual appsec + scoped red team (SOW v1)

Hi Evelyn,

Thanks for the intro via the security channel last month. Attached is our preliminary Statement of Work (BlackPeak_SOW_v1.pdf) for Redwood's annual application security assessment and a capped, 3-day scoped red team exercise focused on high-value customer flows. High level:

- Appsec assessment: code review + authenticated API fuzzing + container image scan (4 testers, 5 days)
- Scoped red team: 3-day purple-team-style engagement against session management + billing flows
- Deliverables: executive summary, technical report with repro steps, remediation tracker, and one 90-minute remediation workshop
- Proposed commercial: fixed retainer $42,500 (see SOW for breakdown)

We typically accept one of two evidence transfer methods: (A) SFTP + ephemeral creds that you rotate per engagement, or (B) one-time secure upload to our intake bucket (signed access). We can also connect to an approved Google Drive folder if needed. We do not require persistent agents; our tooling is credentialed and ephemeral.

Please confirm scope, target test window, and preferred evidence transfer approach. If you share your procurement/PO contact we can also draft the DocuSign SOW and provide proof of insurance.

Attachments: BlackPeak_SOW_v1.pdf

Best,
Andrew Cole
Engagement Lead
BlackPeak Security
engaging@blackpeaksec.com

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com>

Date: 2026-04-18T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Proposal — Redwood annual appsec + scoped red team (SOW v1)

Andrew — thanks for the quick turnaround and the SOW. Looping in Karthik (platform sec) and Dev (procurement) for scope and budget alignment.

Quick clarifications before we escalate to procurement:

1) Scope refinements — we need the appsec assessment to include:
   - IaC scanning (CloudFormation/Terraform) and image SBOM review in addition to container image scanning
   - CI/CD pipeline review (brief) for credential handling and build artifacts
2) Red team — this should be explicitly non-destructive and not include social engineering without pre-approval. We want scoped, credentialed tests only.
3) Evidence transfer — our compliance team requires: SFTP or Google Drive link to a folder under our control; any creds must be ephemeral and logged. Can you confirm support for SFTP with audit logging?
4) Insurance / liability — please provide your current certificate (limits) and confirm SOC 2 compliance status.
5) Commercials — $42.5k is in range but we'll need an itemized breakdown and an option for a time-and-materials addon for additional retest hours.

I've attached an internal RFI checklist to help you map deliverables (RFI_pen-test-checklist.xlsx). If you can address the five items above and provide a revised SOW, we'll route to procurement and legal. Tentative testing window we'd ideally target is May 10 — May 17, 2026.

Thanks — Evelyn
Evelyn Hart
Director, Security Programs
Redwood Inference

Evelyn — appreciated. Quick answers inline.

On Apr 18, 2026, at 11:05, Evelyn Hart wrote:
> 1) Scope refinements — we need the appsec assessment to include: IaC scanning and SBOM review...

We can include IaC scanning and SBOM review; we'll add 1 engineer-day to the assessment and update the SOW.

> 2) Red team — non-destructive, no social engineering without pre-approval.

Confirmed. We'll mark social engineering as opt-in and require explicit written approval.

> 3) Evidence transfer — support for SFTP with audit logging?

Yes — we support SFTP with audit logging and can also accept a Drive folder with our intake process. We will provide instructions for ephemeral credential rotation and recommend using short-lived accounts limited to the engagement folder.

> 4) Insurance / liability & SOC 2?

Attached: Liability_Cert_2026.pdf (insurance limits) and we are SOC 2 Type II in-scope.

> 5) Commercials — itemized breakdown and T&M addon

We'll publish a line-item breakdown in the updated SOW and include an optional T&M block for post-engagement remediation support (hourly rate and 20 hours prepaid option).

Next steps:
- I will upload BlackPeak_SOW_v2.pdf with the scope changes and line-item pricing.
- Send DocuSign when you confirm PO contact; you can review via https://app.docusign.com/rooms/BBK-Redwood-SOW-2026
- We can support the May 10 — May 17 window; please confirm by EOD Monday if that still works for procurement.

Attachments: BlackPeak_SOW_v2.pdf, Liability_Cert_2026.pdf

Best regards,
Andrew Cole
